name: figma-design-generator
description: Akash's design tooling for Claude Code: generate Figma designs from Word documents using your own component library.

plugins.name: figma-design-generator
plugins.description: Turn a Word document into a desktop Figma design built from a pinned component library. Pins the library once, extracts .docx content, plans the section-to-component mapping for review, then builds and validates the frame in Figma.
